help.description: List available commands or show detailed command help
help.commandAccepted: A command suggested by autocomplete, such as `roll`
help.title: Command Help
help.available: Commands currently available to you. Use `/help command:<command>` for details.
help.behavior: Without an option, lists the commands available to the current user and groups them by category. With `command`, displays the selected command’s permission, parameters, accepted values, examples, and behavior.

accepted.autocomplete: Select or enter a value; autocomplete provides valid suggestions
accepted.autocompleteComplete: All {{count}} available values are listed below. Type part of a name or value to filter autocomplete.
accepted.numberMinimum: A number greater than or equal to {{min}}
accepted.numberMaximum: A number less than or equal to {{max}}

purge.description: Delete recent messages from the current channel
purge.amount: Number of recent messages to delete
purge.behavior: Deletes the requested number of recent messages from the current channel. Discord bulk deletion restrictions still apply.

reload.description: Reload supported runtime state and reconnect to Discord
reload.behavior: Reloads and validates configuration and English/French localizations, clears generator caches, rebuilds the in-memory command registry, refreshes Discord slash-command registration, cleans up active voice/audio resources, and reconnects the existing Discord client without terminating Node.js. Failed stages are reported while previous valid state is retained where practical. Source-code, startup, event-routing, mechanics, and model changes still require manually restarting `node index.js`.

say.description: Send a message through the bot
say.behavior: Posts the supplied message in the current channel through the bot.

add.description: Create a blank character sheet with a stable CharacterKey
add.keyOption: Unique save key, make it short and remember it.
add.success: Character with key `{{key}}` was created. This CharacterKey cannot be changed. Use `/set` with a field to open its prefilled private form.
add.behavior: Creates and saves a blank character owned by the invoking user. The CharacterKey becomes the immutable save identifier and must start and end with a letter or number; internal periods, hyphens, and underscores are allowed.

damage.description: Deal damage to a character, reducing AR before HP
damage.amountOption: Positive amount of damage to deal
damage.piercingOption: Bypass AR and deal the damage directly to HP
damage.piercingBreakdown: {{amount}} piercing damage was dealt directly to {{hpLabel}}.
damage.normalBreakdown: {{arDamage}} damage was absorbed by {{arLabel}} and {{hpDamage}} damage reached {{hpLabel}}.
damage.behavior: Applies a positive whole-number damage amount to current AR first, then current HP. When `piercing` is true, damage bypasses AR. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

delete.description: Permanently delete a character and all retained backups
delete.warning:
## Permanent deletion
This removes the active save and every retained backup for `{{key}}`. `/undo` cannot restore it.
delete.confirmationDescription: The value is case-sensitive and must match the CharacterKey shown above.
delete.incorrectConfirmation: The confirmation did not exactly match `{{key}}`. Nothing was deleted. Run `/delete` again to retry.
delete.expired: This deletion confirmation is missing or expired. Run `/delete` again.
delete.wrongUser: This deletion confirmation belongs to another user.
delete.success: Character **{{key}}** and all retained backups were permanently deleted.
delete.operationFailed: The character and its retained backups could not be deleted safely. Nothing was intentionally left partially deleted.
delete.behavior: Opens a private confirmation form. Type the exact, case-sensitive CharacterKey to permanently delete both the active save and every retained backup. This cannot be undone, and `/undo` cannot restore the character. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may confirm deletion.

endTurn.description: Restore current AP and MD to their maximum values
endTurn.result: **{{name}}** starts a new turn with {{ap}} {{apLabel}} and {{md}} {{mdLabel}}.
endTurn.behavior: Restores the selected character’s current AP and MD to their respective maximum values. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

gen.description: Generate GM inspiration from a chosen category (DM only)
gen.schemaDescription: Generate GM inspiration from a chosen category
gen.unknownCategory: Unknown generator category: **{{category}}**. Use `/help command:gen` for command details.
gen.title: Generated {{category}}
gen.behavior: Selects one weighted random entry from the chosen localized generator category. Every JSON generator file becomes available after the bot restarts. The complete localized category list appears above; type part of a category name or value to filter autocomplete.

genChar.description: Generate and save a complete random character (DM only)
genChar.schemaDescription: Generate and save a complete random character
genChar.keyOption: Unique save key, make it short and remember it.
genChar.levelOption: Character level; omitted means a random level from 1 to 10
genChar.backgroundOption: NPC background category; omitted means a random background
genChar.behavior: Creates and saves a complete random character under a unique CharacterKey. Level must be 1–10 and is random when omitted; background is also optional and random by default. Statistics, resources, RULEs, armor, weapons, inventory, gold, and possible status effects are generated from the selected level and the game rules.

get.description: Display a character summary or one detailed field
get.unknownField: Unknown character field: **{{field}}**. Use `/help command:get` for command details.
get.behavior: Without `field`, posts the public character summary. With `field`, displays one complete detailed field and its sub-fields. Autocomplete lists CharacterKeys and supported views such as `name`, `race`, `personality`, `statistics`, `rules`, `status`, `equipment`, and `inventory`.

heal.description: Restore current HP, armor, or both to a percentage of maximum
heal.percentageOption: Percentage of the maximum to restore to
heal.behavior: Sets current HP, current AR, or both to the requested percentage of each resource’s own maximum, using the shared rounding rule. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

roll.behavior: Rolls one standard dice group using `COUNTdSIDES`, optionally followed by one signed modifier, for example `1d20`, `2d6+3`, or `4d8-2`. Count must be 1–100, sides 2–1,000, and the absolute modifier at most 10,000. Multiple dice groups, parentheses, and other arithmetic are unsupported. Exact `1d2` and `1d20` rolls return their dedicated GIF; other expressions return a textual breakdown.

errors.invalidFormat: Invalid dice expression. Use `COUNTdSIDES` with one optional modifier, for example `2d6+3`.
errors.diceCount: The dice count must be between 1 and {{maxDice}}.
errors.diceSides: The number of sides must be between 2 and {{maxSides}}.
errors.modifier: The modifier must be between -{{maxModifier}} and +{{maxModifier}}.

rules.behavior: Replies with the public URL for the TTRPG rulebook.

set.description: Set one character-sheet field or field group in a prefilled form
set.behavior: Opens one private modal prefilled with the selected saved field or group. Colon-separated inputs trim surrounding whitespace and require exactly this order: `name` = `firstName:lastName`; `hp`, `ar`, `ap`, and `md` = `current:max`; `encumbrance` = `current:max`; `base-statistics` = `constitution:strength:dexterity:intelligence:speed:perception:charisma`; `derived-statistics` = `initiative:reflexes`. Either name component may be empty. `race` uses separate Name, Physical description, Lore, Skill bonus, and Physical ability inputs. `background` uses separate Appearance, Backstory, and Goals inputs. `personality` uses separate Description and Traits inputs. Traits, status effects, equipment, and inventory use one entry per line. RULEs use one `name:level:description` entry per line; only the first two separators are structural, so descriptions may contain colons. Empty multiline inputs clear their collection. AP must remain whole numbers with `0 ≤ current ≤ max ≤ 10`. Every group is validated and saved atomically. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may edit the sheet.

undo.description: Restore the newest retained pre-change character snapshot
undo.characterOption: Character whose newest backup will be restored
undo.success: Restored character `{{key}}`. The **{{action}}** backup created {{timestamp}} by {{actor}} was consumed.
undo.behavior: Restores and consumes the newest available backup for an active character. Successful `/set`, `/damage`, `/heal`, and `/end-turn` operations each save the complete pre-change character state. Three backups are retained by default; the server’s `characterHistory.maxEntries` configuration can change that limit, and `/reload` applies the new value to later history operations. Repeated undos walk backward through older retained states. Undo does not save the displaced state, redo is not supported, and permanent `/delete` removes all backups. Only the character creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

errors.noHistory: No backup is available for that character.
errors.invalidBackup: The newest character backup is invalid and cannot be restored.
errors.unsupportedSchema: The newest character backup uses an unsupported save schema and cannot be restored.
errors.operationFailed: The character and its history could not be updated safely. No retry was attempted.

editor.tooLarge: This field is larger than Discord’s 4,000-character modal limit.
editor.collectionPlaceholder: Write one entry per line; leading dashes are optional
editor.rulesDescription: One RULE per line: Name: Level: Description. Leading dashes are optional.
editor.collectionDescription: Free-form lines; leading dashes are optional. Empty the form to clear.
editor.textDescription: The previous value is prefilled. Empty the form to clear it.
editor.colonDescription: Use exactly {{count}} colon-separated values; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
editor.title: Edit {{field}}
